text.name: cg_warningWrongDestination
text.text: Contract product %s can only be unloaded at its assigned delivery point.

text.name: cg_warningGroundBlocked
text.text: Contract product %s cannot be dumped on the ground.

text.name: cg_warningCrossFarm
text.text: Contract product %s cannot be transferred to another farm's vehicle.

text.name: cg_cancelBlocked
text.text: This contract cannot be cancelled: work has already started. Deliver the %s to the assigned point.

text.name: cg_forcedPurge
text.text: The contract failed. Protected %s: %s was confiscated.

text.name: cg_baleBlocked
text.text: Contract bales (%s) are not accepted here. Use the assigned delivery point.

text.name: cm_timeWarning
text.text: Contract about to expire: %s (%d min left)

text.name: cm_noPermission
text.text: Only the server admin can change contract rules.

text.name: cm_guard_enabled_tooltip
text.text: Blocks dumping contract product on the ground, transferring it to other farms and unloading it at wrong places.

text.name: cm_guard_blockCancelAfterProgress_tooltip
text.text: A contract cannot be cancelled once harvesting or delivery has started.

text.name: cm_guard_confiscateOnFail_tooltip
text.text: On timeout or forced failure the net product accumulated since acceptance is taken back.

text.name: cm_reward_multiplier_tooltip
text.text: The reward calculated by the game is multiplied by this value.

text.name: cm_reward_failPenaltyPercent_tooltip
text.text: This share of the reward is charged when a contract fails, is cancelled or times out.

text.name: cm_reward_leaseCostMultiplier_tooltip
text.text: Cost multiplier for vehicles leased with the contract.

text.name: cm_reward_min_tooltip
text.text: The reward after the multiplier never drops below this.

text.name: cm_reward_max_tooltip
text.text: The reward after the multiplier never exceeds this.

text.name: cm_limits_maxActivePerFarm_tooltip
text.text: How many contracts a farm may run at the same time.

text.name: cm_generation_maxTotal_tooltip
text.text: Maximum number of contracts on the board at once.

text.name: cm_generation_maxPerType_tooltip
text.text: Maximum contracts of each type on the board.

text.name: cm_generation_refreshMultiplier_tooltip
text.text: Multiplier for the generation interval. Lower means more frequent contracts.

text.name: cm_duration_multiplier_tooltip
text.text: Newly generated contracts get their duration scaled by this.

text.name: cm_duration_warnAtMinutes_tooltip
text.text: Farm members are warned when the remaining time drops below these thresholds.

text.name: cm_compat_overrideBetterContracts_tooltip
text.text: Also apply this mod's reward/limit/generation/duration rules while BetterContracts is loaded. Multipliers stack.

text.name: cm_typeEnabled_tooltip
text.text: When off, no new contracts of this type are generated.

text.name: cm_typeWeight_tooltip
text.text: Generation chance relative to other types. Equal weights keep the game behaviour.

text.name: cm_ui_managePage
text.text: Contract Manager page in the menu

text.name: cm_ui_managePage_tooltip
text.text: Shows or hides the Contract Manager tab in the sidebar. The game's own Contracts page keeps all buttons.

text.name: cm_integrations_discord_tooltip
text.text: When FS25_DiscordBridge is loaded, contract accept/finish/payout, expiry warnings and guard blocks are sent to Discord.

text.name: cm_adminConfirmRefresh
text.text: All unaccepted contracts will be removed and regenerated. Continue?

text.name: cm_adminConfirmCancel
text.text: Contract "%s" will be force-cancelled (guard block bypassed, no money penalty). Continue?

text.name: cm_adminLimit
text.text: Farm has reached its contract limit.

text.name: cm_reputation_enabled_tooltip
text.text: Completed contracts earn points, failures/cancels/timeouts lose points. Points give a reward bonus and an extra contract slot.

text.name: cm_reputation_lossCancel_tooltip
text.text: Points lost per contract cancelled by the player. Admin cancels do not count.

text.name: cm_reputation_maxPoints_tooltip
text.text: Upper bound of the score; the bonus peaks there.

text.name: cm_reputation_rewardBonusMaxPercent_tooltip
text.text: Percent added to the reward at maximum points; linear in between.

text.name: cm_reputation_extraSlotAt_tooltip
text.text: Above this score the farm limit is +1. 0 = off.

text.name: cm_generation_cooldownPerFieldHours_tooltip
text.text: A field whose contract ended gets no new contract for this many game hours. 0 = off.

text.name: cm_reservation_enabled_tooltip
text.text: A player reserves an unaccepted contract for their farm for a short time; other farms cannot take it meanwhile.

text.name: cm_reservation_minutes_tooltip
text.text: Real minutes. The reservation expires on its own.

text.name: cm_resTakenByOther
text.text: This contract is reserved by another farm.

text.name: cm_resFarmLimit
text.text: Your farm already has a reservation.

text.name: cm_resBlocked
text.text: This contract is reserved by %s; it cannot be taken until the reservation expires.

text.name: cm_resTakenBy
text.text: Reserved by %s · free in %d min if not accepted

text.name: cm_schedule_enabled_tooltip
text.text: Weekend and happy-hour bonuses are added to the reward, by real-world clock.

text.name: cm_schedule_weekendBonusPercent_tooltip
text.text: Percent added on Saturday and Sunday.

text.name: cm_schedule_happyHourEnd_tooltip
text.text: If earlier than start, it spans midnight.

text.name: cm_map_showReserved_tooltip
text.text: The field of the contract your farm reserved is marked on the map.

text.name: cm_map_showAvailable
text.text: Show all open contracts on map

text.name: cm_map_showAvailable_tooltip
text.text: Fields of all unaccepted contracts on the board are marked.

text.name: cm_transferSameFarm
text.text: Contract already belongs to this farm.

text.name: cm_transferLeased
text.text: Contracts with leased vehicles cannot be transferred.

text.name: cm_pricing_distanceEnabled_tooltip
text.text: The farther the contract field is from the farm centre (farmhouse, else centre of owned land), the higher the reward.

text.name: cm_pricing_smallFieldEnabled_tooltip
text.text: Fields below the reference area get a bonus that grows as they get smaller.

text.name: cm_pricing_smallFieldRefHa_tooltip
text.text: Fields below this area get the bonus.

text.name: cm_pricing_smallFieldMaxPercent_tooltip
text.text: Maximum percent, reached near zero hectares.

text.name: cm_pricing_typeDifficultyEnabled_tooltip
text.text: Hard jobs get extra percent: stone picking 30, deadwood 25, tree transport 25, rocks 30, weeding 10, hoeing 10, wrapping 10, plowing 5.

text.name: cm_lease_enabled_tooltip
text.text: When off, no contract can be started with leased vehicles; players use their own machines.

text.name: cm_lease_minReputation_tooltip
text.text: A farm below this reputation cannot lease vehicles. 0 = off.

text.name: cm_leaseDenied
text.text: Leasing vehicles with contracts is disabled on this server; the contract started without vehicles.

text.name: cm_leaseDeniedRep
text.text: At least %d reputation is required to lease vehicles; the contract started without vehicles.

text.name: cm_limits_quotaPerDay_tooltip
text.text: How many contracts a farm may accept per game day. 0 = off.

text.name: cm_limits_quotaPerMonth_tooltip
text.text: How many contracts a farm may accept per game month. 0 = off.

text.name: cm_reward_penaltyStepPercent_tooltip
text.text: Each consecutive failure raises the penalty by this much; a success resets it. 0 = off.

text.name: cm_reward_penaltyMaxPercent_tooltip
text.text: The escalating penalty never exceeds this percent.

text.name: cm_reward_partialEnabled_tooltip
text.text: A failed contract still pays a share based on how much was completed. Not applied to admin cancels.

text.name: cm_reward_partialMinCompletion_tooltip
text.text: Below this completion nothing is paid.

text.name: cm_reward_partialFactor_tooltip
text.text: Paid amount: reward x completion x this rate.

text.name: cm_chain_enabled_tooltip
text.text: A farm following the order on the same field (prepare, sow, tend, harvest) gets extra reward on the next step.

text.name: cm_chain_bonusPercent_tooltip
text.text: Percent added to a contract that continues the chain.

text.name: cm_chain_windowDays_tooltip
text.text: The chain breaks if more days than this passed since the previous step. 0 = no limit.

text.name: cm_npc_enabled_tooltip
text.text: A farm that keeps working for the same land owner earns more from that person.

text.name: cm_npc_percentPerJob_tooltip
text.text: Each completed contract for that NPC raises the reward by this much.

text.name: cm_npc_maxPercent_tooltip
text.text: Maximum percent from the NPC relationship.

text.name: cm_quotaDay
text.text: Your daily contract quota is used up (%d). You can take contracts again tomorrow.

text.name: cm_quotaMonth
text.text: Your monthly contract quota is used up (%d). You can take contracts again next month.

text.name: cm_partnership_enabled_tooltip
text.text: The farm holding a contract can take a partner farm; the reward is split by contribution.

text.name: cm_partnership_maxPartners_tooltip
text.text: How many farms besides the owner may join one contract.

text.name: cm_partnership_inviteMinutes_tooltip
text.text: An unanswered invite expires after this many real minutes.

text.name: cm_partJoined
text.text: Partnership formed; the reward will be split by contribution.

text.name: cm_partNotOwner
text.text: Only the farm holding the contract can invite.

text.name: cm_partAlready
text.text: That farm is already a partner.

text.name: cm_partNoInvite
text.text: You have no invite for this contract.

text.name: cm_partNotMember
text.text: You are not a partner on this contract.

text.name: cm_partInviteNotify
text.text: You were invited to share the contract "%s" (Farm %d). Accept it on the contracts page.

text.name: cm_partAcceptedNotify
text.text: Farm %d accepted your invite for "%s". The reward will be split by contribution.

text.name: cm_pageSelectHint
text.text: Select a contract from the list.

text.name: cm_dialogInviteText
text.text: Choose the farm to share this contract with.

text.name: cm_pageAction_reserve
text.text: Holds this contract for your farm

text.name: cm_pageAction_invite
text.text: Invites the target farm to share this contract

text.name: cm_pageAction_partnerAccept
text.text: Accepts the partnership invite you received

text.name: cm_pageAction_transfer
text.text: Hands the contract to the target farm

text.name: cm_pageAction_assign
text.text: Starts this contract for the target farm
